    The module of a line #

    The constant thin representation of the piece D_{S_L} of a line L (k at each point, identities on the arrows) respects the cover (respectsCover_lineRep): paths inside the line have nonzero value, and parallel paths inside the line are equal. A contour of P (two different paths with the same nonzero value) acts by zero on its push-down (pdAct_contour_eq_zero): lifts of both paths would be two different paths inside the line with the same ends.

    ∃ (p : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk (pt S i)) (RayVert.mk (pt S j))), PathIn (↑S) p ∧ pathVal p = compD S le i j h
